image_description: An underwater shot of a hammerhead shark swimming in blue water. The shark is viewed from a low angle, highlighting its ventral side and the distinctive cephalofoil (hammer-shaped head). The lighting creates strong silhouettes and shadows, obscuring some surface details like skin texture and precise coloration. Other fish are visible in the background.
